notes: Native GenUI fixes: working task and React controls, source-derived chart/calculator behavior, custom glass icons, and history/relaunch fixes. Corrected custom discount calculators and absent-input handling. Build 150 uses the existing shipping signature and installs over earlier builds.
knownLimitations: The iOS device IPA is unsigned and requires re-signing with your Apple account before installation; the simulator app cannot install on an iPhone.
Exact whole-phone reference pixel parity and physical haptic/background-wake delivery are not certified.
